candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in inventory, causing 503 on /v1/reservations, which propagates as ReadTimeout to order and 502 on gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis server-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (load, saturation, network) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out at ~2s with DependencyUnavailable, 503 on /v1/reservations, ReadTimeout to order, and 502 on /v1/checkout across multiple correlation IDs. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout and p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics to confirm saturation vs network fault
Logs excluded (ev-...-logs) to corroborate timeout origin
